wallet.connectDescription: Your plan and operations belong to the wallet you connect.
wallet.changedBody: This belongs to {{expected}}, but {{current}} is connected. Switch back to continue.
wallet.changedReason: Switch back to the original wallet to continue

activate.title: Activate your plan
activate.subtitle: Link the plan to your wallet and choose which balances VicTy tracks. Nothing is bought yet.
activate.noUsdcBody: Your plan is kept as it is, but you can't invest until the wallet holds USDC.
activate.overBudgetBody: Your plan keeps its planned budget of {{budget}}. Each purchase is limited to the {{available}} actually in the wallet.
activate.reserveNote: Keep about {{reserve}} SOL aside for network fees. It stays outside the composition and is never invested.
activate.reserveLowTitle: SOL balance is below the suggested reserve
activate.reserveLowBody: The wallet holds {{quantity}} SOL against a suggested {{reserve}} SOL for fees. Transactions may fail without it.
activate.scopeIntro: VicTy only tracks the assets of this plan. Other tokens in your wallet are left out.
activate.scopeLocked: Tracking is active for these assets. Changing it is recorded as a new update.
activate.costUnknown: Cost basis not known. VicTy won't show a cost for balances you already held.
activate.confirmPreexisting: I understand that existing balances are tracked without a known cost.
activate.activeBody: Choose an asset to review. You authorize each purchase separately in your wallet.
activate.investTitle: Choose an asset to invest in
activate.notApproved: This asset can't be bought right now
activate.noScopeReason: Select at least one asset to track
activate.needConfirmReason: Confirm the existing balances to continue
activate.walletReason: Switch to the wallet these balances belong to
activate.inProgressTitle: An operation is already in progress
activate.walletMismatchBody: These balances belong to {{expected}}, but {{current}} is connected.

review.title: Review your purchase
review.subtitle: Check the details, then authorize this one purchase in your wallet.
review.loading: Preparing your quote and checking the asset
review.expiredBody: Prices move. Request a new quote and review it again.
review.noTransactionBody: We have nothing to send to your wallet, so no signature is requested. Refresh the quote to try again.
review.refusedBody: You declined the request, so nothing was bought. Refresh the quote to review again, or cancel.
review.reloadedTitle: This review needs a new quote
review.reloadedBody: The earlier signature request is no longer available. Refresh the quote to continue.
review.restrictedBody: Buying is blocked for this asset right now.
review.restrictedReason: Buying is blocked for this asset
review.inconclusiveTitle: We couldn't confirm this asset is available
review.inconclusiveBody: The availability check was inconclusive, so purchases stay blocked until it is.
review.noReviewBody: The details of this quote aren't available. Refresh the quote to continue.
review.blockedReason: This purchase is blocked, see the message above

operation.title: Operation status
operation.subtitle: What actually happened with this operation.
operation.refreshError: We couldn't refresh the status just now. We'll keep trying.
operation.effectiveMissing: The final amounts aren't available yet

text.preparing: We are preparing the quote and checking the asset.
text.ready_for_review: The quote is ready. Review it and authorize it in your wallet.
text.awaiting_signature: Waiting for your signature in the wallet.
text.rejected: You declined the signature. Nothing was bought.
text.sending: Your signed transaction is being sent to the network.
text.pending: The transaction was sent and is waiting for confirmation. A slow network is not a failure, and we keep checking.
text.confirmed: The transaction is confirmed on the network.
text.failed: The transaction did not go through.
text.expired: The quote expired before it was authorized. Nothing was bought.
text.reconciling: We're matching your wallet with the network to be sure of the result. This is not a failure.

operation.balanceUpdated: Confirmed. Your balance is up to date.
operation.checkFirst: Check the transaction before trying again, so you don't repeat a purchase that went through.
operation.restOfPlan: The rest of your plan stays planned. Nothing else was bought.
operation.waitReason: Wait until the previous attempt is settled
operation.retryNotSettled: The previous attempt is not settled yet, so we did not start a new one.
